note: group circuits is the closest of the five existing atlas groups; the page is electrostatics, not circuits

description.zh: 静止点电荷的电场、叠加、场线、等势线与试探电荷运动；二维教学模型，k = 1，真空，不含导体与磁场。
description.en: Fields of stationary point charges: superposition, field lines, equipotentials and a released test charge. A 2D teaching model with k = 1 in vacuum, without conductors or magnetism.

reason.zh: 多个电荷的电场逐点矢量相加，是叠加原理的一个具体例子。
reason.en: The fields of several charges add as vectors point by point, a concrete case of the superposition principle.

label.en: A field is a vector field

reason.zh: 每一点的 E 都有大小和方向，用箭头表示并按矢量相加。
reason.en: E has a size and direction at every point, drawn as arrows and added as vectors.

reason.zh: 试探电荷运动中动能加势能保持不变，与功能关系同一账本。
reason.en: A test charge's kinetic plus potential energy stays constant, the same ledger as the work–energy relation.

title.zh: 怎样把看不见的力画成图？
title.en: How do you draw an invisible force?
